info.title: Who to See First
info.subtitle: Matching your symptom to the right first appointment

rows.title: Gradual hearing loss
rows.desc: Start with a full hearing evaluation

rows.title: Sudden hearing loss
rows.desc: See a physician the same day

rows.title: Ear pain or drainage
rows.desc: Needs a doctor, not a hearing test

rows.title: Ringing or fullness
rows.desc: Audiologist assesses and refers if needed

rows.title: Dizziness or vertigo
rows.desc: Have a physician evaluate it first
